Wrote channels.json from the "competitive" preset: 4 text and 15 voice channels.

  #general         text, auto-join
  #lfg             text, auto-join, slow mode 60 s, messages live 8 h
  #scrims          text, messages live 7 d
  #strats          text
  Hangout          voice
  Duo 1            voice, max 2
  Duo 2            voice, max 2
  Trio 1           voice, max 3
  Trio 2           voice, max 3
  Squad 1          voice, max 4
  Squad 2          voice, max 4
  Team 1           voice, max 5
  Team 2           voice, max 5
  Team 3           voice, max 5
  In-House Lobby   voice, max 12
  In-House Team A  voice, max 5
  In-House Team B  voice, max 5
  Review Room      voice
  AFK              voice, no screen share

Restart the server to load it. To change a password for good, put
"password": "…" in place of that channel's "password_hash".

- The room sizes are caps: a full Duo room keeps a third person out, so a team is never interrupted mid-match.
